params.body:
## Why

The gateway learned `issue.open` (abovebeyond-ai/control#85, v0.28.0) so a session can mirror a project's findings as GitHub issues: the file in the repository stays the source, the issue is the workbench for triage, and the pull request that fixes it closes the issue.

A kind has to stand in Elixir's grant (abovebeyond-ai/elixir#222) and in this capability; the gateway refuses anything that is not in both. This is the capability's half.

## What

`issue.open` added to `Capability::WORKBENCH_KINDS`, with the reason in the docblock. Creating a project and issuing a token stay out, as before.

## Tests

`CapabilityKmsTest` and `IngestCapabilityTest` pin the list; both updated, 10 tests, 47 assertions, green.
params.title: The workbench capability carries issue.open
